summary: Lewis Hamilton confronts the consequences of his Singapore miscalculation as Kimi Antonelli stands one victory away from clinching the world championship at the Circuit of the Americas. McLaren hunts for damage control while Ferrari seizes the momentum to support their championship contender, setting up a high-stakes battle over strategy and tire management in Texas. A win for Antonelli ends the title fight definitively and crowns a new world champion, while Hamilton's redemption and any miscues from the front-runners could dramatically reshape the final championship picture.
